lines.x: Anything you need help with, Boss? Good.
We aren't allowed to sleep on the ground here? I'll put up a tent in the hallway, then… That won't do either? Why not? In my tribe, we'd just sleep wherever we were when we got tired.
Doctor, why was my application to room with Lancet-2 rejected? Because she's a robot? Uh, you're mistaken. The two of us are sisters now. She's my big sister, and I'm her little sister.
Doctor, are medics outside all like Gavial? When she gives me my Oripathy checkups, it feels like she's just trying to beat me up… That's why we always end up fighting once I can't take it anymore.
High Priest? Right, he didn't come with me, but he did say he'd visit from time to time. Speaking of which, does he even know where Rhodes Island is...?

It used to be my dream to build a robot as huge as the nomadic cities. Now, my dream is to build a talking robot as huge as the nomadic cities. Master Closure already promised to teach me everything she knows about machines.
Oh, I get it now. So, just like 'Great Chief', 'Doctor' is a title we use to honor the wise. Then, everyone will start calling me Dr. Zumama once I learn everything I can here, right? Oh, they won't?

Doctor, I was hoping you could come back to Sargon with me, when you have time, to teach me how to do all sorts of things there. But you look busy… In that case, can I ask Lancet-2 to go with me? Or Master Closure would be fine, too.

People outside are always worried about things that don't matter, they even fight over them. It's so strange. You too, Doctor. You look like you're giving yourself a hard time about everything. Here, take this wrench. Let's build some machines together. I'm sure you'll like seeing a machine in the works getting bigger and better, bit by bit.
I'm starting to get a bit tired myself, watching the Doctor sleep… *yawn*…
I passed all the exams, so that means I can stay here, right? I want to learn how to build a talking robot like Lancet-2… Oh, codename? My name is Zumama. Can't I use that as my codename?
To think there's someone who could go toe-to-toe with Gavial…
A promotion? Is that something like going from a fighter to a warrior? …In that case, we have to celebrate. I think I'll enjoy a barbecue with Lancet-2 on the bridge tonight.

The High Priest told me how big and vast this great land is. He sounded kind of heartbroken when he talked about it. I didn't understand why at the time, but I'm starting to get it after spending so much time here. Vastness might not necessarily be a good thing.
Is it time to hunt?
What are we hunting?
Are you coming too, Doctor?
I just need to take care of all of them, right?
Ready to go anytime.
I'll go.
It'd be even more efficient to take someone who can work with me.
Hold the fort? Easy.
You people are no match for Gavial!
I'm not all that weak either!
I'll give it my all no matter the prey!
Strike! And got you!
What a great haul!
Compared to Gavial, you've still got a ways to go.
I'll go after them.
Don't worry about it. I've lost to Gavial too many times myself. It's nothing to be ashamed of.
Where's Lancet-2?
Y e a h ?
What do I need to do to become as learned as the Doctor?
Arknights.
Doctor, is there a holiday today…? New Year's? We welcome in the new year…? I don't understand, we don't have this holiday in my tribe. But everyone looks happy. Can I join in? Where is Lancet-2?
Doctor, good timing. There's something I wanted to ask you.

I think I've seen how you celebrate your birthdays. You make a wish and tell it to no one, in hopes that it will come true in the following year. Can I make a wish too? I can? Then, let's close our eyes… Hmmm… Oh, right, happy birthday, Doctor.

I read in a book that today is a day to show my loyalty to my boss and prove my sincerity. Doctor, I'm struggling with the concept of loyalty. This is a heart-shaped badge I designed and built myself on the Engineering lathe. Why is it heart-shaped? Doesn't that represent loyalty?
